zh-Hans: 入弯还挺像样嘛。不过我跟得轻轻松松！
en: Not bad on corner entry. But I can keep up without breaking a sweat!

zh-Hans: 刹车可是我的拿手好戏！
en: Braking is my specialty!

zh-Hans: 只要我认真，就不可能输！
en: If I get serious, I can't lose!

zh-Hans: 拿出百分之一百二十的专注，就像冲进赛道第一个弯那样！
en: One hundred and twenty percent concentration! Just like diving into the first corner on the circuit!

zh-Hans: 我在赛道练出来的全力刹车，竟然输给了只会跑山的家伙！
en: My circuit-honed full braking is losing to some mountain racer!

zh-Hans: 竟然输给了只会跑山的家伙！
en: I'm losing to some mountain racer!

zh-Hans: 可恶，我绝不会就这么算了！
en: Damn it! I'm not letting this slide!

zh-Hans: 看招！必杀，超绝究极超级延迟刹车！
en: Here goes! My ultimate, ultra-super late braking!
Cocky little punk!
Ugh!
Grr!
Aaagh!

zh-Hans: 怎么可能！不可能，绝对不可能！
en: No way! Impossible! That can't happen!
Aaaargh!
Damn it!
Th-that's impossible!
He's already way over there!
D-d-damn it!
Agh! No, I'm losing my nerve!

zh-Hans: 我可是赛道练车日磨炼出来的，怎么可能输！
en: I've honed my skills at circuit track days. There's no way I'll lose!

zh-Hans: 跟得上我在赛道练出来的全力刹车吗？
en: Can you keep up with my circuit-honed full braking?

zh-Hans: 以为能跟上我，那你就大错特错了！
en: If you think you can keep up, you're dead wrong!

zh-Hans: 马上让你连我的影子都看不见！
en: I'll be out of sight in no time!

zh-Hans: 前面的长直道就是机会，我要甩掉你！
en: That long straight ahead is my chance. I'll shake you there!

zh-Hans: 我果然很快嘛，说不定还挺帅的！
en: I really am fast. Pretty cool, too!
I'm not letting that guy get away with this!
He needs to be taught a lesson!

zh-Hans: 这下我对自己的技术更有信心了！
en: Now I'm even more confident in my skills!
See? That's all there is to it!
Now!
Hee-hee! Got you!
Hee-hee! Too slow!

zh-Hans: 嘿嘿嘿，马上让你连我都看不见！
en: Heh-heh! I'll be out of sight in a second!
Hee-hee-hee!
Heh-heh-heh!
Pfft! You crack me up!
Am I cool or what?

zh-Hans: 跟在赛道练出来的我比，你还差得远呢！
en: You're no match for my circuit-honed skills!
I might be a little too cool!
I might be a little too cool!

zh-Hans: 本地车手也比想象中能跑嘛。
en: These local racers are better than I thought.
Aren't we in trouble here?

zh-Hans: 只是暂时让他吧？后面还会超回去吧？
en: You're just letting him lead for now, right? You'll pass him later, right?
W-we're not going to lose, are we?
Whoa!
Hey, isn't this bad?
H-he's fast!
Aaagh!
Wow, that's embarrassing!
This guy's slow!
We're pulling away! Ha! Serves you right!
